headline: Broad demand lifts growth; billings guidance raised again
summary_short: Revenue grew 20% to $2.08B and billings grew 29% to $2.34B, with product revenue up 37%. Fortinet raised 2026 revenue guidance to $8.125B-$8.215B.
summary_long: Non-GAAP operating margin was 38% and operating cash flow was $946M. The share repurchase authorization was increased by $1.2B, leaving $2B remaining. Fourth-quarter guidance is revenue of $2.155B-$2.245B, billings of $2.775B-$2.925B and non-GAAP EPS of $0.93-$0.95. Full-year non-GAAP EPS is guided to $3.54-$3.58. This is the third billings guidance raise this year.
confidence_notes: Billings, non-GAAP operating margin, non-GAAP EPS and free cash flow are non-GAAP. The release excerpt read gives no prior-year values for EPS or margin, so deltas are omitted for those.

drivers.explanation: CEO cites broad-based demand across the portfolio and leadership in AI security, with network security as the foundation.
CEO says strong execution and demand allowed Fortinet to raise 2026 billings guidance for the third time this year.
